name: Living current / luminous filaments
description: Thousands of curved strokes follow the street’s light contours. They turn gently like a magnetic field, while the signature wave moves the whole drawing.

name: Cathedral / molten glass
description: The crossing becomes a field of irregular glass panes, with gold bevels and slowly turning jewel light.

name: Ribbon relief / a folded street
description: The camera sculpts overlapping colored ribbons. Highlights rise into crests, with dark gaps beneath the folds.

name: Paper theatre / loose layers
description: Cobalt, vermilion, rose, and ochre cutouts move slightly apart. Torn edges cast small shadows over the layer below.
